title: Portuguese Vegan Skewers
description: A delicious and flavorful vegan skewer dish inspired by Portuguese cuisine, featuring marinated vegetables and a hint of garlic.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
Soak the skewers in water for at least 30 minutes before use.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, chili flakes, salt, and pepper.
Add the sliced vegetables to the marinade and toss to coat.
Thread the marinated vegetables onto the skewers, leaving some space between each piece.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until the vegetables are tender and lightly charred.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley.
Optional: serve with a side of quinoa or couscous for a more filling meal.
